rust_summary: experience for server mods: reading orbs (`native_experience_orbs`), giving points as an orb does (`native_give_experience`) and giving or taking levels (`native_give_levels`).
doc_summary: `native_experience_orbs(dimension, min, max)`, the experience orbs in a box; `native_give_experience(uuid, points)`, points given to any player as an orb they touch gives them (Mending first); and `native_give_levels(uuid, levels)`, levels given or, negative, taken. Bundles need "hooks": @API:give_experience@.
